e8b_fixed22_amendment.status: AUTHORISED BY THE USER; core execution still requires a separate explicit approval

decisions.topic: removal of max-over-epochs checkpoint selection from the primary B2/B3 core protocol
rule: exactly 22 training epochs for every B2 and B3 core cell
the canonical PRIMARY checkpoint is the epoch-22 checkpoint
primary R1/R2/R3 results and the B3 minus B2 causal contrast use epoch 22
any best-of-22 checkpoint or metric is retained only as a clearly labelled secondary diagnostic and never determines the primary comparison, the model freeze or the clean-test checkpoint
decisions.purpose: remove unequal, run-dependent and max-over-epochs development-selection bias from the primary B3 minus B2 contrast
decisions.epoch_22_justification: a dated post-diagnostic amendment: 22 covers the observed diagnostic best epochs (20, 11, 6), removes endogenous run-length differences, and coincides with the previously registered 15/22 resource basis

decisions.topic: the execution rule lives INSIDE the hashed recipe
decisions.rule: build_core_recipe encodes max_epochs 22, early_stopping false, patience disabled, canonical_checkpoint_rule epoch_22, canonical FP32 evaluation, BF16 training, the strict deterministic backend and the protocol family for B2/B3. A recipe emitting max_epochs 100 or patience 10 for an LM arm is INVALID.
decisions.family: e8b-fp32-fixed22-core-2026-08-07 (bumped so that every earlier checkpoint family, including the pre-fixed-22 core family under which no checkpoint was ever written, fails resume)

decisions.rule: the abandoned search is NOT re-ranked. BOTH plateau statistics are INVALIDATED: the mean-of-top-(n-7) statistic (window length depended on the run's own length; outcome-conditioned; constructed after results were seen) AND the replacement mean-of-top-16 statistic (its selection pools of 30, 21 and 16 epochs still differ, so selection into the top k remains length-dependent). No statistic derived from Grids 1-3 may select the final core recipe or support a superiority claim in EITHER direction. Grids 1-3 are exploratory protocol-diagnostic runs only.
decisions.abandonment_rests_on: the persisted paired McNemar tests (exploratory_fp32_correctness.npz: p 0.9040, 0.4858, 0.5616) and the measured single-arm seed spread (45 rows) exceeding the whole grid spread (36 rows); NOT on any epoch-history statistic

decisions.rule: assert_lm_buffer_parity runs in the executable B2/B3 path after model construction and before scientific training, comparing persistent AND non-persistent buffers against the counterpart arm; failure is a recorded hard halt

decisions.topic: strict determinism at the point of use
decisions.rule: enforcement is re-imposed after every reseeding point (utils.set_seed, random-LM loading, build_arm, the overfit gates), asserted after build_arm and again immediately before the first optimizer step, recorded as verified_at_use in every scientific run, and the codebase scan of determinism-affecting calls is regenerable from determinism_call_scan.py
